# Original Meaning composition through a nominal type

The first selected example describes a bit flip as two reference Meanings
through a nominal `Flag`. The first two versions try to construct the enum
from an ordinary bit. The record version expresses the same intermediate
carrier using the current finite basis expressions. Its first refusal occurs
when the selected preparation encounters the nominal port.

The closed project starts with bit zero and observes the checked composition's
result. The tensor case pairs a three-label enum with a bit and checks the
inverse of the exact phase on the bit axis.
